space.name: env_layout_17
space.notes: T-K part 1's room with an A/C switch between two shelves (Hadi's design, 3 October 2026), for the tests of context knowledge on kitting, in the IRB (idle robot) and the MPB (working robot): env_layout_15 plus ac_switch_0 at (0, -480) on the south wall, straight south of the table between shelf_1 and shelf_4; every other object as in env_layout_15 (its notes give the fan's places, bearings and distances). ac_switch_0 is at -90.0 deg and 930 cm from the table; its bearing is 9.5 deg from shelf_4's and 9.8 deg from shelf_1's, its centre 153 cm from shelf_4's and 158 cm from shelf_1's, so a walk from the table to the A/C switch and a walk to either shelf differ by under 10 deg in heading, against 22.8 to 34.9 deg between the other neighbours. The walks from the table are 537 to 930 cm; the other stated consequences as in env_layout_15. corner_NE (450, 450) the one landmark; one A/C switch (the V1 rule, T-K AM18); no door, no obstacles. Not designed to produce a recognizer result.

env_objects.notes: The middle of the north wall, against it; the one kitting table, shared.
The south wall, west of centre; -99.8 deg from the table, 913 cm.
The east wall, north of centre; -34.0 deg from the table, 537 cm.
The east wall, south of centre; -56.8 deg from the table, 867 cm, between shelf_2 and shelf_4 by bearing.
The west wall, at mid-height; -134.7 deg from the table, 640 cm.
The south wall, east of centre; -80.5 deg from the table, 912 cm.
The south wall, between shelf_1 and shelf_4; -90.0 deg from the table, 930 cm, 9.8 and 9.5 deg from their bearings; the room's one A/C switch.

Landmark (T-C1): the exit walk's target; a place for the human's script only; no task binds it. 50 cm in from both walls. From kitting_table_0 its bearing (0.0 deg, along the north wall) is 34.0 deg from the nearest target's (shelf_2); (450, -450) would be 6.6 deg from the coffee machine's. From the coffee machine the walk here passes through shelf_2's footprint, from shelf_4 27 cm from it.
